frameworks.name: Logical Framework Approach (LFA)
frameworks.description: Standard matrix mapping Challenge -> Impact -> Outcomes -> Outputs -> Activities -> Inputs/Resources with Personas, Metrics & M&E.

frameworks.name: Logical Competency Framework (LCF)
frameworks.description: Competency-based framework mapping skills, behaviors, learning progression, and mastery indicators across stakeholder tiers.

onboardingQuestions.question: Welcome to the Programme Design Companion! Let's get to know you. What is your name?
What is your primary role or designation in education program design?
Which State or Geography do you primarily design interventions for?
What is your main Programme Focus Area?

deflectionMessage: I'm designed to help with programme design, education-related knowledge, and programme planning. I'd be happy to help you design a programme, explore frameworks, or answer questions related to education and programme implementation.
